text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my... is that so? 
Ufufu, what did you think? Pretty groovy, 
wasn't I?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
It was breathtaking... But still, 
I couldn't help wondering how you felt, 
Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...You really are such a sweet girl. 
Thank you. But don't worry, I'm just fine.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it! It's not about me being 
sweet or anything. 
It's just... I felt so frustrated deep 
down.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san, you made this year's 
qualifiers look like a breeze too, didn't 
you? 
You did breaststroke in freestyle... and 
completely blew everyone away in the other 
events...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Chiyo-chan, you see...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I know. Even if it's just for fun, a match 
is a match. 
You're not the kind of person who holds 
back... But still...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
No one could make you push yourself to the 
limit...! 
When I realized that, I felt... so 
terribly frustrated!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've made up my mind. I'm going 
to train even harder before the finals. 
I'll become stronger... And today, I came 
here to tell you that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you be bored this year...! 
So please don't get eliminated until you 
face me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's going to take you down! 
This is my challenge to you!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Chiyo-chan...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
A challenge, huh...? You really are 
something...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You make sure you don't lose before you 
face me either, okay, kiddo? 
I won't just hand over victory, so come at 
me with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes! 
Of course I'll give it my all! I 
definitely won't lose!

—And in the blink of an eye, the day of 
the finals arrived. 
Carrying their own feelings in their 
hearts, the participants set off for 
Makimi Island...!

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
—And so it begins! 
The Splash Rec Finals: The "Water Gun 
Battle"~~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Their swimsuits are so cute~! Good luck, 
everyone!! 
Ooh, they're really fired up~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship-san, 
you haven't forgotten our promise, have 
you?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight I haven't. 'Cause I'm the 
one taking home the trophy!

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, contestants, please head to your 
respective starting points! 
While they do, let's review the rules. 
That said, the rules are super simple!

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
"Get hit by colored water from an 
opponent's water gun, and you're 
disqualified!" That's it! 
Getting soaked in any other water from the 
river or ocean is totally fine!

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
Countless fixed cameras across the island 
will capture all the action! 
You can watch from anywhere on your 
smartphone~! Ah, isn't this exciting?!

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
You can use anything found on the island! 
Physical contact with opponents is 
prohibited! 
Sneak attacks from behind, head-on 
clashes, or teaming up are all allowed.

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
In short, "the last one standing wins"! 
Those are the rules! 
Now everyone, let's give them our loudest 
cheers and get this party started~!

text_block_list.name: Island Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"It's almost time...! The finals are 
finally about to start! 
Who will be the first to spot a rival...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(First, I shall calmly whittle down the 
competition. 
I will set my sights on Gold Ship-san 
after that...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Moving while staying 
hidden 
consumes quite a bit of stamina, doesn't 
it...
Kyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What was that? That scream just now...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-What in the world happened here...? Why 
are you all sitting on the ground... 
Don't tell me all three of you have been 
eliminated already...?

text_block_list.name: Bun Hairstyle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...! The three of us teamed up, but 
Nakayama-san just took us all out in one 
go a moment ago...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Nakayama-san did...?!

text_block_list.name: Goggle-Wearing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, look at that giant sand mound over 
there. Isn't it super suspicious? 
Maybe someone's hiding behind it... Let's 
go check it out!"

text_block_list.name: Bun Hairstyle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Wait! There's something poking out from 
the shadow of the rock near the sand 
mound... 
Isn't that the color of the hem of 
Nakayama-san's jacket?"

text_block_list.name: Swim-Capped Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"I see, a classic bluff of hers. She built 
a sand mound to draw our 
attention while actually lying in ambush 
behind the rock, didn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Bun Hairstyle Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Hehehe, too naive! Let's hit her with a 
pincer attack—wait, huh?!"

text_block_list.name: Three Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Heheheh...! Naive... Way too naive! 
The moment someone thinks they've won, 
they completely let their guard down."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Didn't it cross your minds that the 
jacket sticking out from the rock was a 
bluff too? 
I gambled on whether you'd pick the 'sand 
mound' or the 'rock'!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"If you guys attacked the sand mound, 
or if I couldn't stand the stifling heat 
anymore, I'd lose."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"And! If you picked the rock, 
then just like this, it's a total sweep 
for meeee!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-What a reckless gamble... 
Wait! Is she still nearby...?!

text_block_list.name: Swim-Capped Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Well, it seems she really couldn't handle 
the heat after all... 
She's collapsed over there...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eep! Goodness, look at how covered in sand 
you are! 
Nakayama-san, are you all right?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... don't worry about me. In fact, I 
feel refreshed. 
Heheheh... I'm completely burned out. Put 
me out of my misery with one shot...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, what am I going to do with 
you...! 
Very well. I shall cool you down just as 
you desire.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Take this...! ... 
As a Mejiro Umamusume, this is hardly a 
satisfying way to win.

text_block_list.name: Island Announcement
text_block_list.text:
"—Mejiro McQueen scores a rather 
anticlimactic takedown on Nakayama Festa! 
Only 4 contestants remain. Who will emerge 
as the champion~~?!"
